name: phybot
description: Multi-purpose Discord bot with live music streaming, community tools and a web control panel.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @phybot/shared && npm run build --workspace @phybot/server && npm run build --workspace @phybot/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @phybot/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
